# Pre-tasks Review Checklist: Window Management on the Canvas

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements are complete, clear and consistent before `/speckit-tasks`.
Focus areas: gesture conflicts, maximize and fullscreen state, misbehaving applications, focus
cycling and the view jump.
**Created**: 2026-11-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) (with [plan.md](../plan.md), [research.md](../research.md),
[contracts/input.md](../contracts/input.md), [contracts/protocols.md](../contracts/protocols.md))

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Gesture Conflicts

- [x] CHK001 Is it defined what happens to a second button pressed during a move or resize (for example a right press during a Mod + Shift + left move): ignored, forwarded, or does it change the operation? [Gap, Spec FR-001, contracts/input.md]
- [x] CHK002 Are the shortcuts that may be used *during* a move or resize specified: Mod+Tab, Mod+Q on another window, Mod+0 (a view reset under a dragged window) and Mod+Shift+Q? FR-003 names only Mod + scroll and pinch. [Gap, Spec FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Is plain scrolling (without Mod) during a move or resize defined, given that the window has had pointer leave and gets no pointer input? [Gap, contracts/input.md]
- [x] CHK004 Is the destination of keyboard input during a move or resize stated (does typing still reach the focused window)? [Gap, Spec FR-004]
- [x] CHK005 Is the "nearest corner" rule for the centre cell of the 3 x 3 split defined for ties (the exact centre, or a point on a cell boundary)? [Ambiguity, Spec FR-006]
- [x] CHK006 Is it defined what Mod + Shift + left and Mod + right do on a fullscreen window? FR-014 says moving and resizing leave fullscreen, but not where the grabbed point lands once the window shrinks back to its old size. [Gap, Spec FR-014, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK007 Do the gesture tables in the spec, `contracts/input.md` and the README "Controls" plan agree on every Mod / Shift / button combination, including Mod + Shift + right? [Consistency, Spec FR-002, FR-006, FR-017]

## Maximize and Fullscreen State

- [x] CHK008 Is the combination of maximized and fullscreen defined (fullscreen requested while maximized, and the reverse), including which state survives when the other ends and what each one restores to? [Gap, Spec FR-013, FR-014]
- [x] CHK009 Are maximize and fullscreen requests made *before the window is first shown* specified (an application that starts maximized, `mpv --fs`)? [Gap, Spec US5]
- [x] CHK010 Is it specified which point stays fixed when a window is maximized: does the window keep its canvas top-left and the view jump to it, or does the window move to the view? [Clarity, Spec FR-013]
- [x] CHK011 Is the viewer size used for maximize and fullscreen stated in units (logical canvas units at 100% zoom, given a host scale such as 1.25)? [Clarity, Spec FR-013, FR-014]
- [x] CHK012 Is the placement defined when the application's *minimum* size is larger than the viewer during maximize or fullscreen (FR-013 covers only a smaller maximum)? [Gap, Spec FR-013]
- [x] CHK013 Is it defined whether a resize gesture on a maximized window continues from the restored size, or only restores it and ends? [Ambiguity, Spec FR-013, US5/AC3]
- [x] CHK014 Is it defined what happens to the saved view when the fullscreen window closes, unmaps or its application disconnects? [Gap, Spec FR-014, Key Entities "Saved view"]
- [x] CHK015 When a second window takes fullscreen from a first, is it stated which saved view is restored at the end: the view before the first fullscreen or the first fullscreen view? [Ambiguity, Spec Edge Cases "Two windows ask for fullscreen"]
- [x] CHK016 Is the behaviour defined for a new window that opens while another window is fullscreen (drawn or not, focused or not, does fullscreen end)? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases "Windows the user moved and new windows"]
- [x] CHK017 Is the order of events clear when focus cycling ends fullscreen: is the view restored first and then jumped to the next window, so the restored view is never visible? [Clarity, Spec Edge Cases "Fullscreen window and other input"]

## Misbehaving Applications

- [x] CHK018 Is it specified whether maximize and fullscreen requests from a window *without keyboard focus* are honoured? Today any background application could move the view and take focus at any time. [Gap, Security, Spec FR-013, FR-014]
- [x] CHK019 Is a limit or rule defined for applications that toggle maximize or fullscreen rapidly (each toggle makes the view jump)? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases "Repeated maximize or fullscreen requests"]
- [x] CHK020 Does FR-008 say which limit wins when an application's minimum size is above the largest displayable window, or when its minimum is above its maximum? [Conflict, Spec FR-008]
- [x] CHK021 Are the protocol errors that disconnect an application (`invalid_resize_edge`) reflected in the spec, consistent with FR-016's "ignored without disconnecting"? [Consistency, Spec FR-016, contracts/protocols.md]
- [x] CHK022 Is the behaviour defined for an application that never answers a maximize or fullscreen configure (the window keeps its old size while the view has already jumped)? [Gap, Spec FR-018]
- [x] CHK023 Does SC-006 list every misbehaving case the plan tests (stale serials, bad edges, contradictory min/max, never acknowledging, unmapping mid-operation), so each can be traced to an Edge Case? [Traceability, Spec SC-006, research W12]

## Focus Cycling and View Jump

- [x] CHK024 Is "most recently used" defined: does every focus change count (click, new window, move/resize start), and where does a never-cycled new window go in the order? [Clarity, Spec FR-011]
- [x] CHK025 Is it stated whether each intermediate window reached while Mod stays held gets real keyboard focus (and the application sees the focus change), or only the final one? [Ambiguity, Spec US3/AC3, FR-011]
- [x] CHK026 Is it defined when the order is committed if Mod is released while RubickWay does not have the host's keyboard focus (the release is never seen)? [Gap, Spec FR-011]
- [x] CHK027 Are the single-window edge case ("the view still moves to show it") and FR-012 ("only when not fully inside the view") consistent? [Conflict, Spec FR-012, Edge Cases "Focus cycling with zero or one window"]
- [x] CHK028 Does FR-012 say whether the 5% margin applies only when zooming out or also to the "fully inside the view" test and the centring? [Clarity, Spec FR-012]
- [x] CHK029 Is the view jump defined for a window too large to fit even at the minimum zoom (10%)? [Edge Case, Spec FR-012]
- [x] CHK030 Is the view jump for a *maximized* window defined: centre at the current zoom, or the maximize view at 100%? [Gap, Spec FR-012, FR-013]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK031 Can SC-004 ("no visible stutter on the author's machine") be checked objectively, or should it name a measurable signal (for example frames presented per second during a drag)? [Measurability, Spec SC-004]
- [x] CHK032 Are the quickstart manual checks W1-W14 traceable to the user stories and requirements they prove, so a missing FR shows up? [Traceability, quickstart.md]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
